start_row = 8

min_col = 1
max_col = 12
answer_last_row = 30

today = datetime.now().date()
first_day_current_month = date(today.year, today.month, 1)

def as_date(v):
    if isinstance(v, datetime):
        return v.date()
    if isinstance(v, date):
        return v
    return None

# Capture all data rows from row 8 to the real worksheet end, keeping only rows whose L date
# is in/after the current month.
kept_rows = []
for r in range(start_row, ws.max_row + 1):

    if row_has_data and l_date is not None and l_date >= first_day_current_month:
        row_data = []
        for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1):
            cell = ws.cell(r, c)
            row_data.append({
                "value": cell.value,
                "style": copy(cell._style),
                "number_format": cell.number_format,
                "font": copy(cell.font),
                "fill": copy(cell.fill),
                "border": copy(cell.border),
                "alignment": copy(cell.alignment),
                "protection": copy(cell.protection),
            })
        kept_rows.append(row_data)

# Use the existing first data row/header styles as blank-row style templates.
blank_templates = []

for c in range(min_col, max_col + 1):
    cell = ws.cell(template_row, c)

        "style": copy(cell._style),
        "number_format": cell.number_format,
        "font": copy(cell.font),
        "fill": copy(cell.fill),
        "border": copy(cell.border),
        "alignment": copy(cell.alignment),
        "protection": copy(cell.protection),
    })

# Write only within A8:L30: shifted kept rows at top, remaining cells cleared.

    if idx < len(kept_rows):
        source_row = kept_rows[idx]
        for offset, c in enumerate(range(min_col, max_col + 1)):
            target = ws.cell(r, c)
            source = source_row[offset]
            target.value = source["value"]
            target._style = copy(source["style"])
            target.number_format = source["number_format"]
            target.font = copy(source["font"])
            target.fill = copy(source["fill"])
            target.border = copy(source["border"])
            target.alignment = copy(source["alignment"])
            target.protection = copy(source["protection"])
    else:
        for offset, c in enumerate(range(min_col, max_col + 1)):
            target = ws.cell(r, c)
            tmpl = blank_templates[offset]
            target.value = None
            target._style = copy(tmpl["style"])
            target.number_format = tmpl["number_format"]
            target.font = copy(tmpl["font"])
            target.fill = copy(tmpl["fill"])
            target.border = copy(tmpl["border"])
            target.alignment = copy(tmpl["alignment"])
            target.protection = copy(tmpl["protection"])
